title: Nightly school-portal check
intro: Each night the dashboard checks school portals and Slack, then ranks every deadline and hold into one list. Pick a night to replay.
source: Real priority engine, run on the project's test feed (made-up items, no personal data).

steps.label: Check 7 school sources
steps.detail: Canvas, 12Twenty, CAESAR, NUHS, BidReg, CMC-Slack, Internship-Slack

steps.label: Flag registration and payment holds
steps.detail: Any hold-risk item due in the next 4 weeks jumps to the top

steps.label: Rank everything into one list
steps.detail: Holds first, then anything due within 48 hours, then by category and date

steps.label: Write dashboard_state.json
steps.detail: Shown in the dashboard and menu-bar popup
